title: Growth Analyst Jr.
description:
About the job

En Rabbit buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Growth Analyst Jr.




Esta posición formará parte del equipo de Growth y es una excelente oportunidad para quienes buscan iniciar o consolidar su carrera.




Buscamos una persona organizada, analítica, orientada al detalle y con muchas ganas de aprender, que quiera desarrollarse en un entorno digital dinámico y participar en iniciativas que impactan directamente la experiencia y recurrencia de nuestros usuarios.




🎯Tu misión




Apoyar en la ejecución, configuración y monitoreo de campañas y flujos automatizados de comunicación, contribuyendo a mejorar la adopción, recompra y engagement de nuestros usuarios.




📌Responsabilidades principales




• Configurar y programar campañas de comunicación en plataformas de CRM y Customer Engagement.

• Ejecutar pruebas A/B y dar seguimiento a sus resultados.

• Crear y administrar audiencias y segmentaciones para campañas de engagement y recompra.

• Monitorear indicadores de desempeño, entregabilidad y funcionamiento de los canales de comunicación.

• Dar seguimiento a eventos, flujos automatizados e incidencias dentro de las plataformas.

• Colaborar con equipos de Growth, Retención y Negocio para asegurar la correcta ejecución de campañas.

• Apoyar en la generación de reportes y seguimiento de métricas clave.




✅Requisitos




• Licenciatura concluida.

• Recién egresados o con hasta 2 años de experiencia profesional.

• Inglés avanzado.

• Interés por desarrollarse en áreas de Growth, CRM, Customer Engagement o Marketing Digital.

• Atención al detalle y capacidad de organización.

• Gusto por el análisis de datos y la tecnología.

• Curiosidad, iniciativa y disposición para aprender.




💻Conocimientos técnicos




• Manejo intermedio de Excel o Google Sheets.

• Familiaridad con herramientas digitales y plataformas tecnológicas.

• Conocimiento básico de métricas digitales, marketing o análisis de datos.

• Interés por aprender sobre automatización de marketing, segmentación de audiencias y plataformas de Customer Engagement.







📍 Ubicación: Santa Fe, Ciudad de México

🏢 Modalidad: 100% presencial

🕒 Horario: Lunes a jueves 8:30 am a 5:30 pm | Viernes 8:30 am a 2:30 pm

💼Ofrecemos: Un entorno dinámico, aprendizaje constante y la oportunidad de desarrollarte dentro de un equipo enfocado en crecimiento, experiencia del cliente y automatización de marketing.




Si te interesa iniciar tu carrera profesional en un entorno digital de alto crecimiento y buscas una oportunidad para aprender, desarrollarte y generar impacto, te invitamos a postularte adjuntando tu CV a la postulación.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The E-commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

Responsibilities


 Support central projects to drive platform growth and achieve multiple targets, including but not limited to campaigns, affiliate, content scenarios, shoptab.
 Able to conduct meticulous resource management, market research and other operational works with moderate guidance.
 Coordinate related cross-functional teams' resources to ensure the normal and orderly development and implementation of the projects.
 Communicate with back-end support teams to keep optimizing infrastructure construction.
 Conduct consistent tracking of project performance metrics as required. Able to identify and come up with improvement plans for responsible projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently in the penultimate year pursuing a bachelor's degree.

 Good interpersonal skills, strong ownership and result-driven. Able to adapt to the flexible working cadence of the team.
 Internship experience in large ecommerce platforms, or leading Internet companies is a plus.
 Good understanding of the ecommerce industry & its business structure, consumer needs and demand, influencers, social media, e-commerce, livestreaming, and digital trends landscape.
 Able to commit to at least 3 months internship, 6 months internship preferred.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Support the process of copy optimization, writing copy that is optimized for SEO while remaining entertaining and informative.
Stay abreast of current best practices in the industry and review competitor websites to compare their activities with those of your company.
Cooperate with the content and growth marketing team to create web content and monitor its effectiveness over time.
Based in Mexico City (CDMX) and eligible to work in Mexico. This role is open to CDMX-based candidates only at this time.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or STEM field.
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to create and publish engaging content that establishes or supports company and brand goals.
Expertise in using SEO best practices to write creative copy that includes effective keyword placement.
Highly computer literate and knowledgeable of HTML.
Experience with social media engagement strategies and best practices.
Strong technical knowledge of G Suite.

Process As Needed - We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes as we do products - through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Autonomy - We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.

title: GTM Engineer AI & Growth
description:
About the job

Salario




• MXN 40000 bruto mensual

• Crecimiento profesional: oportunidades aceleradas de aprendizaje y desarrollo en una empresa de rápido crecimiento

• Excelente ambiente laboral: trabaja con un equipo inspirador y divertido en una cultura que valora la colaboración, el crecimiento y la mentalidad customer-first

• Estar en la primera fila transformando toda la industria del Comercio Moderno







Sobre CUBBO







Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce — combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.




Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.







Nuestra Visión







Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.







No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.







Nuestra Misión







Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.







Ubicación







Ciudad de México (Headquarters)




Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto




Sí, no somos 100% remotos.







El Rol




Engage tiene producto, equipo comercial y primeros clientes. Lo que falta es la capa que conecta todo eso: el sistema de Go-to-Market.

Buscamos a un GTM Engineer. Alguien que construye el motor de revenue con sistemas, no con trabajo manual. Cuando encuentras un proceso repetitivo, tu primer instinto es automatizarlo. Cuando una herramienta no hace lo que necesitas, la conectas con otra o construyes algo nuevo.

Tu objetivo: generar leads calificados en pipeline para Engage. La forma de lograrlo es lo que define el rol. No es ejecutar campañas manualmente, es construir el sistema que las ejecuta por ti, incluyendo las campañas de pauta, los flujos de outbound, los lead magnets, y la atribución.

Valoramos mucho más lo que has construido (side projects, automatizaciones, herramientas, agentes) que años de experiencia en marketing tradicional.










Responsabilidades Clave




Construir el motor de demanda como sistema

Diseñar y construir el sistema end-to-end que genera 35 leads calificados en pipeline al mes para Engage

Pensar cada componente como pieza reutilizable: enrichment, scoring, outreach, nurture, pauta, atribución

Identificar lo manual y automatizarlo. Identificar lo automatizado y mejorarlo.

Pauta integrada al sistema

Lanzar y optimizar campañas de pauta dirigida (búsqueda, social, programática) como parte del sistema, no como actividad manual aparte

Construir flujos donde AI genera variantes de copy, segmenta audiencias y reporta resultados sin intervención repetitiva

Decidir presupuesto, canales y mensajes con criterio propio. Apagar lo que no jala, escalar lo que sí.

Lead magnets como producto

Construir lead magnets funcionales (calculadoras, scorecards, simuladores, auditorías con AI), no PDFs

Iterar lead magnets en días, no semanas

Cada lead magnet es un mini-producto que demuestra el valor real de Engage desde el primer click

Stack de GTM con AI en el core

Construir y operar el stack que conecta enrichment, outbound, pauta, AI, tracking y CRM

No te casas con herramientas. Si algo nuevo aparece y comprime ciclos, lo evalúas y lo adoptas. Si algo ya no aporta, lo retiras.

Inbound como output del sistema

Diseñar la estrategia de inbound para Engage (SEO técnico, distribución de contenido, lead magnets)

Sabes qué contenido pedirle al equipo de Content & Brand, y cómo distribuirlo para que jale pipeline

Atribución y visibilidad

Asegurar que cada lead generado tenga atribución correcta a su canal y campaña, donde sea que viva esa data










Habilidades y Competencias




Bias to action: Construyes a veces con información incompleta, antes que planear con información perfecta.

Curiosidad técnica: aprendes herramientas nuevas por tu cuenta, sin esperar capacitación.

Pensamiento sistémico. Resuelves problemas construyendo sistemas, no ejecutando tareas.

Comunicación con candor. Hablas directo, das y recibes feedback sin envolverlo.

Ownership end-to-end. Decides y resuelves sin esperar instrucciones perfectas.







Hard Skills




Uso intensivo de AI (Claude, ChatGPT, APIs) para automatización y construcción

Herramientas de no-code para construir mini-productos: Lovable, Webflow, Sites,etc.

Stacks de outbound y enrichment: Clay, Smartleads/Instantly, Apollo

Manejo de CRM (HubSpot o similar), o disposición fuerte a aprenderlo rápido

Stacks de outbound y enrichment para automatización de prospección

Manejo hands-on de pauta digital (búsqueda, social, programática) tú lanzas, optimizas y mides.










Deseable













Nuestros Valores







Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.







Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.







Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.







Growth Mindset: Siempre estás haciendo preguntas, con hambre de mejorar. Si no te da pena lo que hacías hace seis meses, no estás creciendo lo suficientemente rápido.







Velocidad: Las ideas solas no ganan mercados; la ejecución rápida y efectiva sí. Actuamos rápido, nos adaptamos y convertimos planes en resultados.







Candor: La transparencia y el feedback constructivo son la base de nuestra cultura. Valoramos la honestidad orientada al crecimiento personal y profesional.







¿Por qué unirte a CUBBO?







Sé parte de una revolución







Únete a nosotros para establecer estándares disruptivos en la industria y cambiar la cara del ecommerce en Latinoamérica. Estamos revolucionando la región entera a través de la innovación.







Trabaja con los mejores







Acelera tu crecimiento profesional exponencialmente en CUBBO. Un año aquí equivale a una década de experiencia en otro lugar. Si eres un high-performer que busca un equipo de campeones, tu búsqueda termina aquí.







Construido para durar, construido para ganar







No solo sobrevivimos; estamos creciendo. Nuestra salud financiera nos permite enfocarnos en lo que realmente importa: ganar el mercado y asegurar una experiencia al cliente sin igual.







¿Estás listo para ganar?

description:
About the job

Cardiometabolic Marketing Department

Mexico City

Every touchpoint matters. In this role, you'll shape the strategies that help millions of people start and stay on life-changing treatments — turning consumer data into real health outcomes across one of the fastest-growing therapeutic areas in the industry. We are hiring two Conversion & Retention Coordinators to strengthen our growing team in Mexico City.

Your new role

In this role, you will be at the centre of our consumer conversion and retention efforts, coordinating campaigns and initiatives that help patients start and stay on therapy. You'll combine data-driven thinking with hands-on execution to optimise how consumers move through their health journey.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Coordinating targeted consumer conversion and retention campaigns across multiple channels, ensuring timely delivery aligned with commercial objectives
Analysing consumer journey behaviour to identify friction points, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve progression and retention
Tracking key performance indicators and recommending data-informed optimisation actions across campaigns and engagement initiatives
Collaborating with Sales, Trade Marketing, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and external partners to ensure seamless execution
Preparing regular performance reports, supporting budget tracking, vendor coordination, and maintaining accurate documentation


Your new department

You will join the Cardiometabolic Marketing Department, a dynamic team focused on strengthening consumer engagement across our growing cardiometabolic portfolio. The team works at the intersection of marketing strategy, consumer insights, and cross-functional collaboration — all with a shared commitment to helping more patients access and benefit from treatment. You will report to the Acquisition Manager and work alongside passionate colleagues who thrive in a fast-paced, data-rich environment.

Your Skills & Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is organised, analytical, and energised by the challenge of improving consumer engagement at scale. To succeed in this role, you'll bring:


A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
3–5 years of experience in consumer acquisition, retention, digital marketing, or commercial marketing, including campaign performance analysis and reporting
Advanced proficiency in both Spanish and English is required.
Strong project management and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
A customer-centric mindset with a results-oriented approach and a keen eye for journey optimisation opportunities


Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job — you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline

9 September 2025. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

Pour assurer une continuité opérationnelle avec notre équipe européenne, nous recherchons spécifiquement une personne basée aux États-Unis ou en Amérique latine (LATAM), capable de prendre le relais sur les opérations Ads pendant les horaires de nuit en France.

 Tu aimes exécuter proprement et aller au bout des choses

 Tu cherches d'abord un poste où l'on te forme et t'accompagne en continu. 
 Tu veux évoluer rapidement vers un rôle stratégique. 
 Tu te lasses vite des tâches répétitives.

👤 Pourquoi on a besoin de toi ?

REACH scale très vite, et le périmètre de ce rôle pourra évoluer en fonction de la croissance de l'entreprise. Selon les besoins et ton niveau de performance, des responsabilités additionnelles pourront t'être confiées (data, process, support growth, coordination opérationnelle, reporting). Il n'y a pas de trajectoire imposée : l'évolution dépendra de l'organisation, des projets et de ton impact.

C'est un environnement rare où l'apprentissage est rapide et où tu es exposé(e) aux enjeux concrets de growth, d'opérations et de stratégie.

🚀 Pourquoi REACH ?

REACH est une agence e-commerce unique en France, construite sur 8 ans d'expérience aux États-Unis.

Nous aidons les marques DTC à scale de 1M€ à 30M€+ grâce à une méthodologie robuste et des dizaines de millions d'euros dépensés en Ads.

Rejoindre REACH, c'est :


 travailler dans un environnement ultra formateur,

 voir ton impact au quotidien, 
 évoluer selon ta performance.

Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y nuestro negocio de pagos (POS y online) crece fuerte en México. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar — y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




📍 Modalidad 100% presencial – base en México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




Tu desafío: Vender. Tu cancha es nuestra base instalada de comercios: no vienes a cuidar cuentas, vienes a hacerlas crecer y cerrar ventas de POS. Vas a cazar oportunidades dentro de la cartera, subir el volumen que cada comercio procesa con AgendaPro, ganarles terreno a los competidores y convertir una base de alto potencial —hoy con poco relacionamiento comercial— en volumen real. Hay más de 300 cuentas esperando que alguien las active de verdad. Esa es tu meta.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Vender POS a los comercios de nuestra base actual y cumplir (o reventar) tus metas de venta.

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor (llamadas, visitas presenciales, revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant).

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV del POS: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%; diagnosticar por qué cada uno no procesa más (fricción técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y cerrar la brecha.

• Ganarle al arbitraje: detectar los comercios que usan AgendaPro pero también procesan tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y recuperar ese volumen para nosotros.

• Retención / anti-churn: intervenir apenas una cuenta cae bajo el umbral o muestra señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Coordinar con el equipo comercial en México: asumes la relación comercial y coordinas la mantención con operación y soporte, escalando los temas operativos y de producto a las contrapartes internas.

• Recibir los comercios recién activados (desde activación / onboarding) y asumir su relación de crecimiento.

• Reportar avance: alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requisitos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

description:
About the job

About Kiwi




Kiwi is a Series B consumer lending fintech serving the US Hispanic market, with a focus on underbanked consumers. We've raised more than $120MM across debt and equity, with material room to scale our facilities and loan book. We're looking for a seasoned capital markets professional to work directly with the CEO and Finance teams.




What You'll Do




Own the borrowing base process end-to-end: weekly and monthly borrowing base certificates, eligibility testing, covenant compliance tracking (advance rates, concentration limits, minimum liquidity, leverage caps), and lender reporting across our warehouse and subordinated facilities.
Source and manage lender relationships: cultivate new potential lenders — credit funds, banks, forward-flow buyers, and warehouse providers — including preparing data rooms, fielding diligence requests, and running processes through to term sheet.
Build and maintain the company's core financial models: loan-level cash flow and vintage models, facility-level advance rate and returns models, the corporate three-statement model, and scenario and sensitivity analysis.
Prepare Board and investor materials: Board presentations, lender updates, and analysis supporting equity and debt fundraising.
Support negotiation of credit agreements and amendments alongside management and outside counsel — advance rate tiers, eligibility criteria, covenants, and intercreditor terms.
Partner with the data, credit, and finance teams to turn portfolio performance into strategic decisions.




What We're Looking For




5–15 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, or capital markets; structured finance, specialty finance, or consumer lending coverage strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience preparing borrowing bases, financial projections, and other detailed lender-facing reporting.
Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel and comfort working with loan-level data; experience using SQL to query data and build automated reports.
Exposure to forward-flow agreements, warehouse facilities, and mezzanine debt.
Experience interacting directly with lenders, investors, or credit committees.
Strong written and visual communication — you can turn a model into a Board-ready story.
Self-starter who thrives in a lean team with high ownership.
Bilingual English/Spanish required.




Location




Our finance team is based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, and that's our preference for this role given the close day-to-day work with the CEO and the rest of the team. That said, we're open to strong candidates working remotely from anywhere in Latin America. Periodic travel to Santo Domingo and the US is expected.

About the job

About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About Your Skills


Customer Advocacy: You keep our learners, partners, and administrators at the center of your work, identifying and anticipating their needs and pain points. You thoughtfully advocate for customer needs cross-functionally. 
Project Management: You manage multiple workstreams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive customer-focused projects, adapting quickly to changes. You identify opportunities to improve processes and initiate lightweight project plans. 
Data-driven Storytelling: You analyze quantitative and qualitative data and use your technical platform expertise and critical thinking to identify keen user insights to communicate succinctly and memorably. 
Communication (English): You are fluent in the English language and can communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing 


About This Role


The Product Specialist team sits at the intersection of Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams, translating user signals into structured improvements that enhance platform quality, reduce friction, and enable scalable growth. Product Specialists equip our user-facing teams to provide a seamless user experience on our platform as well as drive user-centric platform enhancements by strategically pinpointing key challenges and opportunities to the right internal stakeholders at the right time. 
The Product Specialist team meets the challenge of internal stakeholders’ competing priorities by nimbly adjusting advocacy strategies to compliment current company priorities. As Product Specialists grow in the role, they take on higher-impact projects and partner closely with leaders in Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support. The role and these projects ensure that our users remain at the center of product and process development across our company. 


What You’ll Be Doing


Use Coursera platform expertise to advocate for and create great learner and administrator experiences by influencing roadmaps, driving issue resolution, and building creative technical solutions

Work closely with our Support teams to directly enable users by driving escalation resolution, triaging issues, and updating internal resources 
Own projects that improve our operational processes and internal tools & resources to improve our effectiveness and efficiency 
Present data-driven support insights to internal stakeholders to showcase trends and guide internal decision-making 
Build strong working relationships with multiple internal cross-functional teams and collaborate to create learners-first solutions 


What You’ll Have


3+ years of experience in customer success, technical support, or client services, working with technical teams 
Demonstrated ability to drive projects that benefit clients, customers, or end users 
Experience with mastering a technical platform and providing technical consultative support 
Written and verbal communication skills (English) to communicate technical information clearly, succinctly, and professionally 


At Udemy, we strive to be transparent around compensation. Actual compensation for this role is based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to a base salary, this role is also eligible for equity.

$440,000—$550,000 MXN

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.

We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.

We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll Build With Others.

We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.

What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together. 

Our Benefits Start With U

At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
About the job

Brand Manager – Teamfight Tactics 

Brand Management at Riot is focused on players and fans. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and creating meaningful experiences across every touchpoint. For Teamfight Tactics, this means celebrating the strategy, creativity, and competitive mastery at the heart of the game while growing a passionate global community around it.

As a Brand Manager II for Teamfight Tactics, you will primarily lead publishing and brand marketing efforts for TFT Esports (approx. 80% of your scope) while supporting broader TFT publishing initiatives and evergreen brand priorities (approx. 20%). You'll help strengthen TFT's competitive identity through integrated campaigns, compelling storytelling, and player-first experiences that celebrate the game's global esports ecosystem. 80% Esports / 20% Game

This is a highly collaborative role that works across Creative, Communications, Social, Regional Publishing, Esports Product, Broadcast, Community, and Production teams to deliver impactful campaigns that grow fandom and support business outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing and this role can be based in Mexico city or LAX.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Campaign Leadership


Steward the TFT Esports brand by developing marketing and communications strategies that strengthen its competitive identity and deepen player fandom.
Lead integrated global marketing campaigns for esports events, tournaments, and competitive moments, from brief through launch, measurement, and retrospective.
Translate player and audience insights into compelling creative briefs, campaign strategies, and marketing plans.
Support broader TFT publishing initiatives throughout the year, contributing to game campaigns and evergreen brand priorities beyond the esports calendar.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Global Publishing


Partner with Esports Product, Broadcast, Competitive Operations, Social, Community, Influencer, and Regional Publishing teams to develop aligned global marketing plans.
Partner with regional publishing teams by providing creative frameworks, marketing assets, and best practices that enable locally relevant execution while maintaining global brand consistency.
Collaborate with Insights, Business Development, Product, and Live Experiences teams to identify opportunities that strengthen the TFT player experience and esports ecosystem.


Creative & Operational Excellence


Steward creative development across esports marketing initiatives, ensuring work reflects TFT's brand, competitive spirit, and player experience.
Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agency relationships, and production partners to deliver high-quality work that is on strategy, on time, and on budget.
Stay closely connected to the TFT community, competitive scene, and broader gaming landscape to identify emerging opportunities and inform future marketing initiatives.


Required Qualifications


3 to 5 years of experience in brand management, product marketing, community marketing, or agency roles within gaming, entertainment, or esports.
Deep understanding of the TFT esports landscape and a nuanced grasp of the players, fans, creators, and communities that shape its competitive ecosystem.
Experience developing and executing integrated marketing and communications campaigns from planning through launch.
Strong understanding of brand fundamentals and experience translating player or audience insights into effective marketing strategies.
Experience working with gaming audiences, live events, or community-driven marketing initiatives.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional and international teams to deliver shared goals.
Experience working with agencies, creative partners, or production teams to bring campaigns to life.
Experience using campaign performance data and audience insights to evaluate campaign performance and optimize future marketing efforts.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.


Desired Qualifications


Familiarity with Teamfight Tactics, Riot Games' portfolio, or competitive strategy games.
Experience partnering with esports product, broadcast, live event production, or game development teams.
Understanding of creative production workflows and integrated global marketing campaigns.
Awareness of emerging trends across gaming, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle marketing.
Active TFT player and engaged member of the TFT community.


You have strong marketing instincts, enjoy collaborating across disciplines, and care deeply about creating campaigns that resonate with players and fans. You balance creativity with thoughtful execution and are motivated by delivering experiences that strengthen TFT's competitive identity and long-term fandom.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Perks: Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k/Private Pension Plan with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Duties

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:


Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters


These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

(Los Angeles Only) Base salary range between $119,400.00 - $167,200.00 USD + incentive compensation + equity + 401K with company match + medical, dental, vision, and life insurance + short and long-term disability + open PTO.

description:
About the job

Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week




About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.




This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.




Key Responsibilities

Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week, with additional shorter long-form content as needed.




Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

Business and entrepreneurship
Digital marketing
Business growth and strategy
Educational content
Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
Case studies and business lessons
Personal branding and founder-led content
Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.




What We're Looking For

Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.




Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.




A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.




Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.




Schedule

Part-Time
Approximately 20 hours/week to start
Flexible remote schedule
Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Customer Success Manager will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Customer Success Organization acting as the go-to resource for our valued customers.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for ensuring successful product adoption and retention of key customers in the business. Specifically, you will:


Build custom Mutual Success Plans to align our Salesloft strategy to the customer’s business objectives.
Effectively guide customers in how to prioritize next steps on a Mutual Success Plan, managing multiple points of contact with each customer.
Partner with internal teams on tasks and projects that impact the broader team.
Review trends in customer data and proactively identify focus areas. 
Create impactful QBRs and prioritize data based on insight and the "so what" for each customer.
Identify unusual trends in the data and anticipate key follow-up questions from a customer.
Provide strategic guidance to customers around sales and sales engagement best practices for their use case. Champion industry best practices and challenge customers on their approach. 
Lead customer-facing webinars and internal trainings around industry insights and recommendations. 
Lead phone calls and on-site meetings with stakeholders (including C-Level), navigating both positive and more difficult conversations with ease.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to build long-term, trusted relationships with key executives and influencers. You will own, drive, and affect change for your customers by having an obsessive focus on their outcomes. Daily you’ll focus on driving customer adoption through strategy calls and customized business reviews at the executive level. The goal is to be the ultimate storyteller in showcasing the compelling impact on your customers' business made possible by their use of Salesloft. Remember, you are the quarterback of the customer experience and you will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking an experienced customer-facing professional who will engage, retain, and drive our customers' understanding of Salesloft product offerings working strategically with sales, cs, and leadership (both internally and with the customer). You will be measured on the retention, expansion, and happiness index of a book of business (Salesloft’s customers).

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Customer Success Manager is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft’s Customer Success team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming account management professionals.

The Customer Success team consists of 30 some team members who develop and maintain a deep understanding of the customer’s business drives, goals, and steer activities to align with these initiatives. They act as a liaison between internal teams to ensure customer needs are being met, partner with sales to define and achieve customers’ success criteria, and demonstrate ROI and ensure customers renew the Salesloft Product Suite. We strive to ensure customer satisfaction through inspiring, educating/training, driving adoption, managing stakeholders, and influencing the customer.

THE SKILL SET:


3+ years of experience in a Customer Success role
1+ years of experience using the Salesforce CRM. Must have an intermediate to expert knowledge of Salesforce CRM components such as leads, activities, contacts, opportunities, and reporting. (Salesforce Admin Certification is a plus!) 
Previous experience in a SaaS/Technology company or fast-growing start-up preferred 
Superb listening skills and the proven ability to dig deeper to uncover the customer’s true objectives
High level of empathy - it’s important for our CSMs to be a good person to peers and customers
You are a clear, confident, and compelling communicator — in writing, in conversation, and in front of an audience
You are extremely perceptive and highly emotionally intelligent, making you agile in adapting your executive presence and approach to any audience and personality
You are an expert project manager who ruthlessly prioritizes, manages stakeholder expectations, and ensures all key objectives and timelines are met
You are resourceful, scrappy, and creative — if a playbook doesn't exist yet, you go figure it out and build it for the whole team to use
You are confident in technical conversations — hearing “API” doesn't make you run and hide


WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU’LL:


Attend Salesloft’s New Hire Orientation, where you will learn our Salesloft story and understand what makes our “Lofters” unique 
Join our 3-week Sales Bootcamp, where you will learn our software and all the skills necessary to set you up for success, allowing you to make an impact in the market quickly
Begin 1:1’s with your manager, understand your 30-60-90 day plan, meet & shadow current members of the Salesloft team, and delve into your territory 
Set your OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) with your manager and develop an action plan to achieve them
Meet key partners in Account Management, Finance, Marketing, Executives, etc. - they will be key relationships for you throughout your deal cycle
Become demo certified


WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Begin working with customers
Be Salesloft admin-certified
Be enrolled in our Salesloft PM certification program
Be a product expert and feel comfortable walking a customer through all aspects of the Salesloft platform
Have proficiency in both the Salesloft product capabilities as well as modern sales engagement best practices


WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Be running with your customer success plans to encourage adoption & process optimization
Be able to show quantifiable ROI to customers in the form of success stories
Have a greater ability to understand deep technical aspects of a product and educate customers and peers using simplified explanations


WITHIN TWELVE MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Set an example for new CSMs, and assist in training, onboarding, and motivating new Lofters
Be a proven self-starter and able to come up to speed on complex, difficult concepts with minimal assistance
Have a thorough understanding of the challenges an organization faces when implementing a new technology and how to help them manage change

description:
About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team 

At Fever, our Business Development team is both the face of Fever in the market and the voice of the market within Fever. Sitting at the core of our platform, they connect the world’s best experiences with the largest audiences, helping the live entertainment industry grow and evolve.

Our team builds trusted, long-term partnerships with leading brands across the ecosystem. We work closely with creators, producers, agencies, and cultural leaders to help them make data-driven decisions, expand their portfolios, and scale internationally. In doing so, we play a key role in shaping the future of the entertainment landscape.

This role goes far beyond relationship management. It requires strong strategic thinking and problem-solving across a wide range of topics, from marketing and pricing to operations and financing. The most successful team members take full ownership of their partners’ success, acting as true partners and advisors at every stage of growth.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Business Development works hand-in-hand with Marketing, Category Management, Partner Support, Operations, Tech, Product, and Finance to ensure every experience on our platform reaches its full potential.

Our team is diverse, entrepreneurial, and dynamic, bringing together talent from consulting, banking, big tech, and startups. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where creativity meets data, and ambition meets execution.

Join us if you’re passionate about discovering world-class experiences, building meaningful partnerships, and scaling some of the most exciting concepts across the globe.

The Role

In this role, you will drive Fever’s expansion across Mexico's entertainment industry by building and nurturing deep commercial relationships with top producers, creators, venues, and key stakeholders. You will develop and execute an innovative growth strategy to scale our market presence, expertly managing commercial strategies to ensure mutual value creation and build sustainable, long-term partnerships with event organizers. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams both in Mexico and internationally, you will successfully balance a growing client base while serving as our in-house expert on the coolest trends and newest experiences in the entertainment landscape.

What You'll Do


Develop and deliver a growth strategy for the market, with an innovative and effective approach to scaling Fever's presence in the region
Expertly manage commercial strategy with large partners ensuring value creation for both parties, and a sustainable strategic partnership between Fever and event organisers
Create and cultivate deep business relationships with the biggest producers, creators, venues and key stakeholders in the entertainment industry
Evidence strong organizational skills to effectively balance and grow a large base of clients 
Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders to successfully deliver on partner growth across Mexico and internationally
Keep up to date with everything cool that’s happening in the entertainment; think of yourself as the expert for new and trending experiences


Who You Are

Here’s what you should bring to the table:


At least 5+ years of top tier consulting or top tech equivalent experience, plus another 4+ years of relevant experience.
Strong business development and partnership management skills
Self-starter mentality with an ability to work in a demanding, dynamic start-up environment
Demonstrated data-driven approach to business and task prioritization
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal along with strong attention to detail
Comfort in working with Microsoft Office, Google docs, and a Sales CRM 
Knowledge of the city’s entertainment, events, and lifestyle trends


Why You'll Love It Here


Attractive compensation package, including stock options to reward your contributions and growth.
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México y Colombia para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.
