About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

This job is open to candidates working remotely from anywhere
Schedule: You must be available during core U.S. business hours, especially mornings and early afternoons when client, field, and operations communication is most active. Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process
Compensation: 1250 USD/month first 90 days, 1500 USD/month after that. Bonus to be established after 90 day onboarding, bonus range of 8000 USD every 12 months
Commercial Landscaping Business | Remote via ScaleSource | Bilingual English/Spanish


Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

You do not need to know all of these, but you need to be tech-comfortable and able to learn quickly.


Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

A short video submission might be required at the right stage of the process.

Everyone gets a response within 24 business hours.

About the job

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH


You’ll join our Customer Center of Excellence (CoE) within the Bain Capability Network (BCN), a global team that partners with Bain case teams and practice leaders to shape high impact commercial opportunities and strategic client pursuits.

Within the CoE, you’ll work alongside a collaborative and internationally distributed team focused on customer growth, brand strategy, marketing, sales excellence, and go-to-market strategy. The team plays a critical role in helping Bain develop compelling executive-level proposals, pitch materials, and commercial narratives for complex client situations across industries and regions.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Bain consultants, Customer Practice leaders, and senior stakeholders globally, bringing together strategic thinking, customer insight, and strong storytelling to support some of Bain’s most important growth opportunities.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM


As a Lead, you will play a key role in shaping strategic client pursuits and commercial growth initiatives across Bain’s Customer Practice. You’ll lead the development of high impact proposals, executive presentations, and pursuit strategies that translate complex business challenges into clear, compelling, and client-ready narratives.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, storytelling, and commercial problem solving. You’ll help teams identify and position growth opportunities, support senior stakeholders in high priority pursuits, and drive structured thinking across fast paced and often ambiguous business situations.

You will also lead and mentor a team of Associates and Analysts, fostering high quality delivery, strong problem solving, and a collaborative, growth-oriented team environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead the development of high-impact sales collateral (proposals, pitch decks, RFP/RFI responses) for priority client opportunities across regions
Rapidly assess client contexts, including business models, competitive dynamics, and financial positioning, to shape effective pursuit strategies
Act as a strategic partner to BCN leadership and Customer Practice teams to unlock growth opportunities and strengthen Bain’s go-to-market approach
Lead senior stakeholder discussions, bringing structured problem solving, clear perspectives, and compelling storytelling to ambiguous business challenges
Drive high quality, detail oriented delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams
Lead and manage teams of Associates and Analysts, providing coaching, feedback, and quality oversight
Build reusable assets, commercial playbooks, and innovative perspectives to support scalable growth and future client development
Partner with cross-functional teams to enhance Bain’s methodologies, tools, and intellectual property
Leverage technology, automation, and AI tools to improve proposal development and content efficiency
Support internal operations, including leadership updates, business reviews, and knowledge management

ABOUT YOU

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
5+ years of relevant experience in consulting, customer strategy, brand marketing, commercial strategy, proposal development, sales enablement, agency strategy, or related strategic business environments
Experience in B2C-focused industries such as Consumer Products, Retail, Telecommunications, or Financial Services is preferred
Proven experience developing client-facing materials (proposals, pitch decks, RFPs) in areas such as customer strategy, marketing, sales, or growth strategy
Strong analytical capabilities and advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel
Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx) is a plus
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
Demonstrated leadership experience, including managing or mentoring team members
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Fluency in English required; please submit your resume in English

WORKING MODEL
This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence four days per week at our Polanco (Mexico City) office.

LIFE AT BCN IN MEXICO CITY

Curious about what it’s like to work within Bain Capability Network in Mexico City? Hear directly from members of our team about the culture, career growth, collaboration, and impact of BCN at Bain.

Learn more here:

https://www.bain.com/careers/life-at-bain/careers-blog/an-inside-look-at-bain-capability-network-in-mexico-city/

RECRUITING PROCESS
Our interview process includes a combination of behavioral and case interviews. As part of the process, you will be asked to complete a case interview to assess your problem-solving and analytical skills. A case interview is a structured, real-world business scenario where you’ll walk through your thinking and approach to solving a client problem.


We highly encourage you to review Bain’s case interview preparation resources here: 

https://www.bain.com/careers/interview-prep/

Floowi connects top LATAM professionals with leading U.S. companies through remote talent solutions. Our mission is to make LATAM the world’s premier hub for growth and excellence.




🌟 About our Client:

Our client is a digital marketing agency that combines strategic consulting with integrated digital execution. Its services span strategy and planning, branding and creative, paid digital, social media, analytics, automation, technology, and web experiences, supporting businesses across multiple industries with data-driven marketing solutions.




✍ Short Description:

The Digital Marketing Coordinator supports the execution, optimization, and ongoing management of integrated digital marketing initiatives across multiple client accounts. This is a multi-channel execution role spanning areas such as paid search, paid social, SEO, organic social, email marketing, programmatic, reporting and analytics, tagging, content, and light creative support. The role is responsible for keeping campaigns, deliverables, reporting, and follow-up activities accurate, coordinated, and on schedule while monitoring performance and identifying issues and opportunities. Success requires strong cross-channel exposure, analytical thinking, organization, and the ability to manage multiple client priorities in an agency environment.




🌎 Location: 100% Remote (LATAM only)

🗣 Language Requirements: Advanced English (C1+)

⏰ Schedule: Full-time, aligned with EST

😀 Start Date: ASAP




💰 Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive salary in USD
Remote-first flexibility. Work from anywhere.
PTO and paid U.S. holidays




💼 Responsibilities:

Execute, optimize, and manage ongoing integrated digital marketing initiatives across assigned client accounts, including paid search, paid social, SEO, organic social, email marketing, programmatic, reporting, analytics, tagging, content, and light creative support.
Own assigned client account tasks, campaigns, deliverables, timelines, optimizations, reporting needs, and follow-up items, ensuring accurate and timely execution across multiple priorities.
Support campaign builds and launches, including setup, budget pacing, optimization, QA, reporting configuration, tagging, and performance monitoring.
Monitor campaign performance, budget pacing, campaign health, reporting accuracy, and platform setup to identify issues, opportunities, and areas requiring additional support.
Coordinate with practice leads, Client Services, creative, content, analytics, and MarTech teams to keep client work moving and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
Conduct QA across campaign setup, tracking, reporting, creative, content, and other deliverables before launch or delivery.
Develop and maintain performance reporting, translating campaign results and trends into clear insights, recommendations, and next steps.
Proactively communicate blockers, risks, performance concerns, and executional issues while collaborating with stakeholders to resolve them.




💡 Qualifications:

2+ years of digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency environment.
Experience working across multiple digital marketing channels, including several of the following: email marketing, paid search, paid social, SEO, organic social, programmatic advertising, reporting and analytics, and graphic design.
Experience managing multiple clients, campaigns, projects, and timelines simultaneously.
Familiarity with digital marketing platforms and tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, email marketing platforms, SEO tools, programmatic platforms, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or similar reporting tools, and project management platforms such as Asana.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, with HubSpot strongly preferred.
Basic familiarity with creative and content tools such as Figma, Canva, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into clear insights, recommendations, and next steps.
Strong organization, attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across teams in a fast-paced agency environment.




📩 If you meet the experience outlined above, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply—our team is excited about your application and will be in touch as soon as possible.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
skills: We’re humans not robots
Customers always come first
We work better together
Simplicity is our strength
Our reputation is priceless
Hard work pays off

Own the email process, through QA and delivery, working directly with content, creative, events, lifecycle, customer marketing, product marketing and demand generation to build branded emails that are sent with the highest quality and efficacy.
Build, QA, deploy, and optimize email campaigns end to end in Marketo, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, deliverability checks, and scheduling.
Work collaboratively with email stakeholders to QA every send using Litmus and AlertMedia's email build standards (link accuracy, UTM parameters, tracking, and rendering) before it goes live.
Build and maintain campaign infrastructure, including workflows, templates, and smart campaigns, to enable scale and consistency across marketing.
Create, maintain, and audit sales email sequences in Outreach.
Serve as project manager driving alignment and approvals with key stakeholder for all email campaigns
Manage ongoing operational tasks across Marketo and Salesforce, including list management, lead routing support, form and workflow maintenance, and data hygiene.
Maintain data quality on form fields (validation rules, required fields, duplicate handling) to protect lead database integrity.
Partner with web and development teams to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies between Marketo tracking and form submission data.
Regularly audit and optimize data flow between Marketo programs and Salesforce campaigns, ensuring campaign member status mapping is accurate.
Maintain naming conventions and folder structures for Marketo programs to support scalable reporting across marketing.
Coordinate webinar logistics across marketing and other departments, including registration setup, reminder and follow-up sequences, platform configuration, and post-event lead handoff.
Build and maintain Marketo programs (webinars, in-person events, virtual conferences) using standardized program templates to ensure consistent tracking across all event types.
Ensure Salesforce campaigns are set up correctly, so funnel tracking and attribution are correct.
Set up and QA registration and confirmation emails, calendar invites, and reminder or follow-up sends tied to event and webinar programs.
Ensure program success flags and channel and program tagging align with attribution models for accurate marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced reporting.

Pull and maintain reporting on email and nurture campaign performance (opens, clicks, conversions, pipeline influence), surfacing insights, flagging anomalies, and communicating deliverability and list-quality issues clearly to non-analytical stakeholders.
Use those insights to inform A/B testing and continuous optimization of engagement, conversion, and ROI working in close collaboration with the Lifecycle Marketing Manager.
Build and maintain repeatable processes and documentation so campaigns launch consistently, and the team can scale execution without sacrificing quality.
Own end-to-end execution of global campaigns, ensuring scalable, repeatable program delivery across email, paid search, webinars, events, and account-based marketing.
Coordinate email localization efforts with EMEA reviewers as well.
Pilot AI-aware patterns and automation (for example, prompt-driven builds) within the email workflow, and partner with GTM Engineering to replace manual steps.
Support enrichment workflows in Clay to improve data quality and routing accuracy.
Understand and monitor compliance and database hygiene tasks including GDPR, opt-in management, unsubscribes, and invalid or suspended records.
2-3 years of experience in a marketing operations, campaign management, demand generation, or email marketing role, ideally at a B2B technology company.
Must have hands-on experience with Marketo.
Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or other CRM platforms to build emails, forms, lists, workflows, smart campaigns, and dynamic content.
Strong attention to detail and a QA mindset — you catch broken links, mis-segmented sends, and tracking gaps before they go live.
Experience with audience segmentation, list hygiene, and email deliverability at scale.
Solid organizational and project -management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
Ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product marketing, and event teams to keep multi-stakeholder programs on track, often on tight cycles.
Reporting and analytics literacy — comfortable pulling campaign metrics and translating them into clear, actionable summaries.
Self-starter who can own recurring operational work independently and reliably from start to finish.
The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment.
Exceptional English communication skills  (oral and written).
Familiarity with enrichment, data, or account-based marketing tooling (such as Clay) and analytics tools.
HTML/CSS skills for troubleshooting email.
Experience supporting a high-volume and fast-paced marketing team.
An affinity for learning complex, highly technical products and strong technical aptitude, generally.
Familiarity with GDPR and email compliance requirements.
Experience with LLMs and a point of view on how AI can up-level day-to-day operational work.
Competitive Base Salary (Bi-Monthly payroll)
Annual Company Bonus
100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Parental Leave Program
Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo)
Generous Vacation and Holiday Policy
Additional Vacation Bonus
Monthly Work-from-Home Stipend
All Necessary Equipment Provided: Laptop, monitor and accessories
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins big and small
Language Immersion Program with employees spread out across the globe (English, Spanish, etc...depending on your interest)
Continuous Learning & Growth: From mentorship and tech talks to personalized 1:1 career development sessions, we’re deeply committed to investing in your professional journey
Award Winning Culture: We're proud to be recognized as a BEST WORKPLACE FOR 10 YEARS IN A ROW
The Work & People: We’re passionate about the meaningful work we do—and even more grateful for the incredible people we get to do it with!

About the job

Do work that matters. 

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:


We’re humans not robots 
Customers always come first 
We work better together 
Simplicity is our strength 
Our reputation is priceless 
Hard work pays off 


As one of the fastest growing software companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand. We’re also an AI-forward company, and we expect everyone on our team to use modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and others, to work smarter, move faster, and optimize processes.

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to help build, execute, and continuously improve the campaigns that power AlertMedia's marketing engine. You'll work hands-on in Marketo and Salesforce to launch email and nurture programs, keep our CRM and marketing automation systems clean and connected, and partner with enrichment and workflow tools like Clay and Wrike to bring more automation and consistency to how the team operates. This role suits someone who is equal parts builder and troubleshooter: comfortable in the technical weeds of a platform, but just as comfortable explaining a deliverability issue or a tracking gap to a non-technical stakeholder. 

What you get to every day:  

Email & Campaign Execution 


Own the email process, through QA and delivery, working directly with content, creative, events, lifecycle, customer marketing, product marketing and demand generation to build branded emails that are sent with the highest quality and efficacy. 
Build, QA, deploy, and optimize email campaigns end to end in Marketo, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, deliverability checks, and scheduling. 
Work collaboratively with email stakeholders to QA every send using Litmus and AlertMedia's email build standards (link accuracy, UTM parameters, tracking, and rendering) before it goes live. 
Build and maintain campaign infrastructure, including workflows, templates, and smart campaigns, to enable scale and consistency across marketing. 
Create, maintain, and audit sales email sequences in Outreach. 
Serve as project manager driving alignment and approvals with key stakeholder for all email campaigns 


Marketing Operations & CRM Support 


Manage ongoing operational tasks across Marketo and Salesforce, including list management, lead routing support, form and workflow maintenance, and data hygiene. 
Maintain data quality on form fields (validation rules, required fields, duplicate handling) to protect lead database integrity. 
Partner with web and development teams to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies between Marketo tracking and form submission data. 
Regularly audit and optimize data flow between Marketo programs and Salesforce campaigns, ensuring campaign member status mapping is accurate. 
Maintain naming conventions and folder structures for Marketo programs to support scalable reporting across marketing. 


Webinar & Event Program Support 


Coordinate webinar logistics across marketing and other departments, including registration setup, reminder and follow-up sequences, platform configuration, and post-event lead handoff. 
Build and maintain Marketo programs (webinars, in-person events, virtual conferences) using standardized program templates to ensure consistent tracking across all event types. 
Ensure Salesforce campaigns are set up correctly, so funnel tracking and attribution are correct. 
Set up and QA registration and confirmation emails, calendar invites, and reminder or follow-up sends tied to event and webinar programs. 
Ensure program success flags and channel and program tagging align with attribution models for accurate marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced reporting. 


Reporting, Process & Documentation 


Pull and maintain reporting on email and nurture campaign performance (opens, clicks, conversions, pipeline influence), surfacing insights, flagging anomalies, and communicating deliverability and list-quality issues clearly to non-analytical stakeholders. 
Use those insights to inform A/B testing and continuous optimization of engagement, conversion, and ROI working in close collaboration with the Lifecycle Marketing Manager. 
Build and maintain repeatable processes and documentation so campaigns launch consistently, and the team can scale execution without sacrificing quality. 
Own end-to-end execution of global campaigns, ensuring scalable, repeatable program delivery across email, paid search, webinars, events, and account-based marketing. 
Coordinate email localization efforts with EMEA reviewers as well. 


Automation & Compliance 


Pilot AI-aware patterns and automation (for example, prompt-driven builds) within the email workflow, and partner with GTM Engineering to replace manual steps. 
Support enrichment workflows in Clay to improve data quality and routing accuracy. 
Understand and monitor compliance and database hygiene tasks including GDPR, opt-in management, unsubscribes, and invalid or suspended records. 


What you bring to the role:


2-3 years of experience in a marketing operations, campaign management, demand generation, or email marketing role, ideally at a B2B technology company. 
Must have hands-on experience with Marketo. 
Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or other CRM platforms to build emails, forms, lists, workflows, smart campaigns, and dynamic content. 
Strong attention to detail and a QA mindset — you catch broken links, mis-segmented sends, and tracking gaps before they go live.

Solid organizational and project -management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines.

In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.

description:
About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

LATAM

Welcome to 10Pearls! 

We believe in harnessing the power of technology for social good through our core values: Innovate, modernize and accelerate.

 

Description

We are seeking a Salesforce Implementation Consultant to join our growing Salesforce practice. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for implementing and supporting Salesforce solutions, with an initial focus on Sales Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, formerly Pardot. The ideal candidate combines strong Salesforce administrative skills with excellent communication and consulting abilities. This person should be comfortable leading client conversations, understanding business processes, translating requirements into practical Salesforce solutions, configuring those solutions, testing them, documenting decisions, and training end users.

Responsibilities

Lead client discovery sessions, gather business requirements, and translate sales and marketing processes into practical Salesforce solutions.
Configure Salesforce Sales Cloud, including Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Activities, security, automation, Outlook Integration, reports, dashboards, and forecasting.
Configure Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, including Salesforce connectivity, field mappings, forms/form handlers, lists, segmentation, email templates, sending/tracker domains, and basic automation.
Support data migration and validation activities, including field mapping, contact imports, unsubscribe/opt-out handling, testing, and reconciliation.
Develop implementation documentation, facilitate UAT and launch readiness, and conduct administrator and end-user training.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly while collaborating with clients, project managers, developers, architects, and other internal teams.

Requirements

3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration, consulting, or implementation experience, with strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud.
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot) or a comparable Salesforce-connected marketing automation platform.
Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration, including data models, fields, page layouts, permissions, validation rules, Flow, reports, dashboards, and data management.
Proven ability to gather requirements, facilitate client conversations, and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce configurations and recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and training skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage priorities, identify risks, and deliver quality work within project timelines.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

Salesforce Certified Administrator.
Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant and/or Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist/Consultant.
Previous experience working for a Salesforce consulting partner, digital agency, or professional services organization and supporting implementations from discovery through go-live.

What We're Looking For

Success in this role requires more than knowing where Salesforce settings are located. We are looking for someone who can listen to a client describe a business problem, ask the right follow-up questions, recommend a sensible solution, configure it correctly, and confidently explain the result to the client. The strongest candidates will be comfortable moving between client meetings and hands-on Salesforce configuration and will take ownership of their work from discovery through testing, training, and launch.

About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

This role will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for key fraud projects. You will work closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and external vendors to design and launch secure, compliant fraud systems that enable Kraken to operate across jurisdictions while protecting users from fraud and supporting investigations—without disrupting legitimate client activity. This role requires strong product ownership, cross-functional coordination, and experience working with fraud/ATO detection/prevention mechanisms and fraud case management.

The opportunity


Own the product strategy and roadmap for fraud solutions, including running the project to revamp case management for fraud and ATO .
Lead end-to-end delivery of fraud features from discovery and design through implementation and launch.
Collaborate with Engineering teams to define technical specifications, APIs, workflows, and operational processes for fraud and ATO.
Work closely with Legal, Fraud Strategy, and Ops teams to ensure products meet requirements across jurisdictions.
Partner with external vendors to define integration scope, capabilities, and technical requirements.
Build systems that support investigations, risk detection, and user protection while minimizing friction for legitimate client activity.
Prioritize initiatives that improve monitoring coverage, attribution accuracy, alerting quality, and operational efficiency.


What You Bring


4+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in fraud, crypto, trading platforms, or financial infrastructure.
Strong understanding of fraud processes and infrastructure.
Experience working with institutional trading products or financial market infrastructure.
Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, finance, compliance, and external vendors.
Experience managing API-based integrations with third-party providers.
Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate complex technical systems into clear product requirements and roadmaps.


Nice to haves


Familiarity with ATO or Identity management
Familiarity with Case Management automation leveraging AI.
Experience with legal, compliance or traditional finance regulations.


Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

AspenTech, is a fast-paced, growing, high technology company. As a world leader in the Operations Technology (OT) field, we develop and supply state-of-the-art energy management, optimization, and control software solutions to energy utility companies worldwide.

Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) is a high growth area in our business that unlocks an electric distribution utility’s ability to monitor, manage, control, and optimize the grid. You will be engaged with our customers supporting efforts to design, build, configure, troubleshoot, and test the deployment of our systems. This position gives you broad exposure to the entire ADMS and will focus on advanced applications such as Distribution Power Flow (DPF), Fault Location Isolation & Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt/VAR Control & Optimization (VVC/VVO). About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Our Field Commercial team is the engine behind DiDi's growth in every market we operate in — building partnerships, driving new business acquisition, and ensuring our commercial strategy translates into real results on the ground. As City Manager, you'll take full ownership of commercial performance in your city, leading a team of BDs (Hunters and Farmers) and acting as the key link between local execution and our broader regional strategy.

In this role, you'll be...


Leading a successful team of Business Development Managers to deliver exceptional performance results and customer service that exceeds expectations.
Enabling operational teams (Business Developers) to achieve the highest standards in execution and to develop and maintain strong business relationships with top customers.
Co-developing commercial propositions for different types of customers, based on deep business insights.
Understanding consumer behavior to gain insights and translating them into actionable plans.
Ensuring the successful execution of commercial plans



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


10+ years of experience in the commercial area with solid experience in key account management and/or consultative selling.
At least 5 years of experience managing teams (manager of managers).
Strategic and Data-Driven thinking. 
Able to bring solutions to complex problems.
Fluent in English.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.
